recommendation: Keep the core audit as-is. Future InventoryItem content changes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator, or through a new work-group decision to move InventoryItem back into core after sufficient maturity and implementation experience.
issue_request: FHIR-39161 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for a generic product resource for inventory, catalog, and supply use cases, and the accepted resolution was that adding InventoryItem in R5 at FMM0 addressed the need, subject to final FMG approval once implementation experience had been gained.
initial_application: Core source commits added and refined InventoryItem: ee4a05d674 added source/inventoryitem and active source/fhir.ini entries, while 3fe49c123c, a4d7148f76, c7445a3ecd, and f837c6003e refined InventoryItem content. The published R5 specification contains InventoryItem as a Draft/FMM0 resource.
additional_context: InventoryItem was intentionally immature in R5. Later FMG/OO discussions placed InventoryItem and related supply resources on the additional-resources path, and commit 3b38b80cf2 removed InventoryItem from active core build configuration while changing the Administration module link to the OO Incubator IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source edit was made because re-adding InventoryItem to source/fhir.ini would reverse the later R6 move out of core; current core source now points to the OO Incubator InventoryItem definition.

related_jiras.note: Later Product pattern work refined InventoryItem scope/usage but does not change that FHIR-39161's R5 resource addition was applied.
